name: Habitica
description: A task and habit manager that turns real-life tasks into game mechanics using an avatar, rewards, equipment, quests and optional social features.
intended_use: Track habits, recurring tasks and one-off tasks when game-like rewards make task management more engaging.
audience_or_context: A general-purpose productivity app for people who prefer game mechanics as part of planning and habit tracking; it is not specific to neurodivergence.
limitations: Reward, penalty and streak mechanics can motivate some people and feel stressful or discouraging to others.
Social and game features add complexity beyond a simple task list.
cost_or_access_notes: A free account is available; optional paid features or purchases may exist and can change.
conflicts_of_interest: Habitica is a commercial service; its own feature descriptions are not independent evidence of benefit.

provenance.method: Official resource surface and current access route checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records identity, function and access without converting first-party marketing or popularity into efficacy evidence or endorsement.
